tickers.description: Rows of { symbol, price, change }. `change` is signed and colors the row.

change.description: Signed change since last close; >=0 green, <0 red

description: A horizontally scrolling market ticker tape — the canonical finance graphic. Renders content.tickers (each { symbol, price, change }) as a seamless marquee that scrolls for the asset's full timing window; change colors each price green/red and each symbol gets a short staggered pop so the row feels live.

borderLine.description: raw hex for the track border; 'transparent' allowed

easing.description: easing token for the enter clip-wipe

glyphGap.description: px gap between symbol/price/change within one ticker

scrollPxPerSec.description: leftward scroll speed in px/sec, fps-independent

showChangeArrow.description: show ▲/▼ next to the change figure

symbolGap.description: px gap between successive tickers in the marquee

trackFill.description: raw hex for the track background; raw literal (key deliberately contains no 'color' so it skips token resolution)

trackHeight.description: track height in px; override defaultSize.height by setting styleOverride.height too

typography.description: typography token for symbol text (price/change derive their own sizes from it)
